description: Key Water Growth Indicators is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides information about key indicators related to water production and consumption in the State of Qatar. It includes figures on total water production, maximum daily production, and number of registered customers including tanker services. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water, production, demand, customers, growth. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
